contentList.content: Wu Xia

Wu Xia are warriors who have mastered the martial arts, combining internal energy cultivation with external combat techniques. They can channel their inner power to enhance attacks, possess keen perception abilities, and master the legendary Six Meridians Divine Sword techniques. 3rd Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="WuXia_DaJinGangShenLi">Vajra Divine Power</LSTag> 5th Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="WuXia_YingYan">Eagle Eye</LSTag> 7th Level - <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="WuXia_LiuMaiShenJian">Six Meridians Divine Sword</LSTag>
Vajra Divine Power

Channel inner power to enhance attack potency. Weapon attacks, unarmed attacks, ranged unarmed attacks, and force damage gain additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> modifier.
Eagle Eye

Possess keen vision and perception abilities. Gain 60 feet <LSTag Tooltip="Darkvision">Darkvision</LSTag>, immunity to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag> condition, and increase ranged weapon range by 50%.
Shaoshang Sword
Fire a sword qi that automatically hits, dealing 2d10 force damage to the target. This sword technique never misses.
Shangyang Sword
Fire a sword qi that automatically hits, dealing 3d6 force damage to the target. This sword technique never misses.
Zhongchong Sword
Release sword qi that automatically hits in a target area, dealing 1d10 force damage to all enemies within 1.5 meters.
Guanchong Sword
Fire powerful sword qi that automatically hits, dealing 1d10 force damage, pushes the target back 3 meters, and may cause them to fall <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
Shaochong Sword
Fire swift sword qi that automatically hits, dealing 1d10 force damage and grants advantage on <LSTag Tooltip="Initiative">Initiative</LSTag> rolls next turn.
Shaoze Sword
Fire armor-piercing sword qi that automatically hits, dealing 1d10 force damage and inflicts <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="VULNERABILITY_FORCE">Force Vulnerability</LSTag> on the target.
Six Meridians Divine Sword

Sequentially release all Six Meridians Divine Sword techniques: Shaoze Sword, Shaochong Sword, Zhongchong Sword, Shangyang Sword, Shaoshang Sword, and Guanchong Sword. This is the ultimate technique of the Six Meridians Divine Sword.
Shaochong Sword Effect
Gain advantage on <LSTag Tooltip="Initiative">Initiative</LSTag> rolls next turn.
Force Vulnerability
Take double damage from <LSTag Tooltip="Force">Force</LSTag> attacks.
